message: Parchments v0.2.6: Fix Android CI release APK packaging & branded launcher icons, solve menu transparency & z-index layering, add inline voice dictation at cursor, fix voice note Markdown formatting & instant transcript reactivity, fix local Studyspace disk reconnection & clear workspace labeling, fix Bible verse selection flow with Pin Range default & optional TSK cross-references, fix local Wi-Fi sync host self-join loop, and responsive toolbar.
